# Brex — account brief

## Who

Brex offers corporate cards and spend management software for startups and enterprises ([source](https://brex.com/)). The GitHub org `brexhq` links brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is committed in `brexhq/brex-mobile` ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/eas.json))
- `package.json` in that repo lists react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json))
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- The org has 27 public repos and 410 followers ([source](https://github.com/brexhq))
- The org description names a regulated category, "financial" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq))
- The iOS app has 28,000 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141))
- Seven App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141))
- An open issue in the repo reads "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87))

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@brexhq-maintainer-1), top contributor to `brexhq/brex-mobile` with 260 commits ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)). Their GitHub profile lists company "Brex" and website https://brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)). No title, team, or location in the evidence.
- Maintainer Two (@brexhq-maintainer-2), 133 commits to the same repo ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-2)). Their profile lists company "Brex" and website https://brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-2)). No title, team, or location in the evidence.
- @brexhq-maintainer-3, 58 commits to the same repo ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-3)). The evidence gives no name, company, or bio for this account.

## Why now

The repo was last pushed 2026-08-15 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile)), and the App Store listing shows seven releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)) with an open issue titled "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)).

## Suggested opener

You have 260 commits in brex-mobile ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)), and there is an open issue on the repo saying the upgrade to SDK 52 is blocked by a native module mismatch ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)). The repo ships with eas.json and its own CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/eas.json), [source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the store listing shows seven releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)). Which native module is holding the SDK 52 move, and does each of those seven releases go through a full store review or do some of them reach users over the air?
